item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
Issued at 05:20 PM 13 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NorthernSamar(Lapinig, Gamay, Mapanas, Palapag, Catubig and LasNavas) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro(Baco, CityOfCalapan, Naujan, Victoria, Pola, Socorro, Bongabong, Bansud, Gloria, Pinamalayan, PuertoGalera, SanTeodoro), #Sorsogon(Bulan), #Masbate(Monreal, SanJacinto, Baleno, Aroroy and Placer) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
